items.title: Why Lululemon (LULU) Shares Are Getting Obliterated Today
items.summary: Shares of athletic apparel retailer Lululemon (NASDAQ:LULU) fell 17.7% in the afternoon session after the company reported a decline in second-quarter net revenue and slashed its full-year sales and profit guidance. According to the company's press release, Lululemon reported net revenue of $2.42 billion, down 4.3% year-over-year, alongside a 9% decline in total comparable sales.
